## What's new

- **NDM Style**, a new look: choose **View → Toolbar → NDM Style** (under Modern style and Classic style). It redesigns every window: rounded controls, one blue accent colour, line icons on the toolbar, a sidebar without tree lines, progress bars and coloured states in the download list, a status bar with the number of downloads and the total speed, flat tabs, rounded groups and lists, and accent-coloured main buttons in the dialogs. With dark mode on, every window turns dark, not just some.
- **Custom scale** (**View → Custom scale...**): make the toolbar, the categories pane and the text of the main window bigger or smaller, from 50% to 200%. Changes show at once.
- **Custom toolbars:** put your own pictures on the toolbar buttons. A toolbar is a folder of PNG files in NDM's toolbars folder (**View → Toolbar → Open toolbars folder**), and NDM lists each one in the Toolbar menu. **Look for new toolbars** now opens the [guide to making and installing them](https://github.com/MoeJoe37/New-Download-Manager#custom-toolbars).
- **Linux, closer to Windows:**
  - links dragged from the browser can be dropped on the main window, not only on the drop target (X11 and XWayland);
  - sites that ask for Negotiate sign in with your Kerberos ticket (from `kinit` or a domain sign-in), as Windows uses your Windows account; NTLM with the name and password in the address works as before.

## Fixed

- A download from the browser extension no longer opens NDM's main window along with the download window when the extension has to start NDM: only the download window comes up, and NDM stays in the notification area (on Linux without a tray icon, the main window starts minimized).

- Linux help: browsers installed as Flatpak, and Chromium from Snap, do hand downloads to NDM while it runs; only starting NDM from the browser is blocked. The help now says so and suggests starting NDM with the computer.
